answer: Proof of Work serves as a lantern guiding nodes toward a singular, resource-constrained truth. By requiring computational expenditure for block validation, the network acts as a reef, breaking the waves of fraudulent identities. Each Sybil must consume energy proportional to its influence, a zephyr of heat against the cold entropy of a decentralized economy. Attackers incur significant capital costs for hardware and electricity, rendering the creation of infinite identities economically irrational and technically unsustainable.
